mentions.name: Strength gains-tracking app
mentions.description: A strength gains-tracking progressive web app designed to be intuitive, motivating, and friend-first. Built as the author's first full PWA with vanilla JS on the frontend and Lucee & MySQL on the backend, it works on iOS and Android. It has been tested with friends for 10 weeks and is planned to go public in a couple of weeks.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm also working on a new strength gains-tracking app that is a lot more intuitive, motivating and friend first. I've been using it with some friends for the last 10 weeks and everyone making is consistent gains. It is my first full PWA, vanillaJs, backend is Lucee & MySQL.
